summary: DouYu International Holdings filed a Form 6-K on August 7, 2026, announcing management changes. CEO Shaojie Chen voluntarily resigned for personal reasons, effective August 6, 2026, without dispute. Co-CEO Simin Ren was appointed sole CEO and Board Chairperson, effective immediately. Jie Gao was appointed VP of Investment and director. The company states normal operations continue with no material adverse effect expected. No financial terms or advisor were disclosed. This is a voluntary, orderly transition rather than a forced departure, but the CEO change is the primary event. Watch for any strategic shifts under new leadership.
